templates.name: home
templates.rationale: Only pages without breadcrumb; identical sequence (index = de.html redirect). Unique mix of anchor-list tabs, key-figures band and image tile grid.

templates.name: section-landing
moduleSequence: card/image tile grid | link-box | image-gallery-tiles | key-figures
templates.rationale: Shared fingerprint: hero immediately followed by a horizontal quicklink teaser-slider strip (2-col teasers with arrow), then a tile/card grid section, then related teasers. Betrieb is a sub-page but uses the same landing layout. Konzern has the most of the family's modules (strip, cards, link-box, gallery, testimonial, related).

templates.name: content-page
templates.rationale: Hero, italic intro text-media, body text with accordions and optional images/CTA/contacts, closing 'Noch mehr Fraport' slider. Nachhaltigkeit is a section root but laid out as a content page (no quicklink strip). Konzernstrategie covers section-title, text-media, accordion, image, media-lightbox, cta and related.

templates.name: card-overview
templates.rationale: Hero + short intro, then a 3-column grid of image cards linking to sub-pages, then related teasers. Service has cta, section-title, card grid, image+text and related (most modules).

templates.name: feature-hub
templates.rationale: Long, multi-section pages with in-page anchor/tab navigation and many rich modules (key figures, pictograms, galleries, milestones, embeds). Newsroom shares anchor-list and teaser-collection with Digitalisierung; International Activities shares pictogram-key-figures and tabbed text-media. Newsroom has the widest module set; note its social/video embeds are consent-gated.

templates.name: utility-detail
templates.rationale: Hero, short content area, stack of accordions; no 'Noch mehr Fraport' related slider (no teaser-slider). Herzensmomente is a campaign page but structurally identical (hero, text-media+image, accordions). Publikationen has download-list + accordions + text-media.

templates.name: news-listing
templates.rationale: No hero, no breadcrumb module in content; search field + filter tabs + dynamic search-results list. Identical sequences.

templates.name: contact-directory
templates.rationale: No hero; grid of contact cards (photo, role, phone, mail, web) plus accordions of further contacts. Only page built around contact-list.

modules.description: Full-width photo with purple italic uppercase title box overlapping bottom-left; absent on listing and contact pages.
Small grey breadcrumb trail under main nav (all pages except home/index and the two listings).
Horizontal teaser carousel: either the quicklink strip under the hero or the 'Noch mehr Fraport' related-content row of 3-4 cards with pagination dots.
Wrapper section for 'Noch mehr Fraport' (section-title + teaser-slider) above the footer.
Teaser card: image, eyebrow, blue title, 'Lesen' link; used in sliders and grids.
Purple slanted label heading (e.g. 'Noch mehr Fraport', 'Konzernstrategie').
Text block with optional side image/video; italic grey lead paragraph variant for intros.
Rich-text body paragraphs/lists (often nested in text-media/tiles).
Responsive lazy image with optional caption, used standalone and inside tiles/text-media.
Blue filled/outline button or text+button band.
Stack of collapsible rows with blue label and chevron (content accordions; footer also uses one).
Image/video that opens in an overlay lightbox (with slider).
Modal overlay container used by lightbox/galleries.
Large numeric stats band (e.g. share price, traffic figures).
Image card in 3-col grid (overview pages, Aktuelles).
Horizontal in-page anchor/tab bar below hero.
Tabs: filter chips on listings, tabbed content on International Activities.
White boxed list of links with heading and buttons, beside an image.
List of downloadable files (PDF icon, title, size).
Grid of contact cards: photo, name, role, phone, email, web.
Large quote block with image (FRA History, International Activities).
Dated news list (date, title, excerpt) with 'more' button.
Dynamic search result list with thumbnails, meta tags, dates and load-more.
Row of line pictogram icons with short labels/figures.
Bulleted arrow link list (inside link-box).
Tiled image gallery grid opening a lightbox slider.
